description: On the pink tabletop in front of you, there’s a white AirPods charging case with a white charging cable attached, with the rest of the cable coiled off to the right. The left hand reaches in from the left to steady the case as a left-hand object, while the right hand comes in from the right to grip the cable plug as a right-hand object and pulls it straight out to unplug it; then the left hand sets the case down to the left and both hands withdraw.
